commonPrompt: Create one square architectural base-colour material tile for a Tokyo living diorama. Flat orthographic material scan, uniform diffuse unlit colour, edge-to-edge single continuous surface. No perspective, objects, text, borders, vignette, directional shadows, highlights, ambient occlusion or baked reflections. Seamless opposing edges. Restrained contrast, credible fine surface detail, quiet broad colour variation. Compatible with both an anime background painting treatment and a tactile miniature material. Do not depict a building or scene.

candidates.prompt: Cool warm-gray poured concrete facade, tiny pores and subdued fine mineral grain, faint irregular tonal wash. No panel boundaries, bolt holes, deep cracks or directional streak shadows.

acceptance: Inspect 3x3 repeats for seams and recognizable repetition before use.

Use the same geometry and camera for both styles at dawn, noon, dusk and night.
Retain separate live glass, emission and lighting roles.
Count resident copies and mipmaps; file inventory alone is not GPU measurement.
Reject candidates that add noise without improving the actual street.
